_doc: Hand-made judgements for card_audit.py. classes: id | gameplay | gameplay-text (rules outcome decided by parsing a free-form string) | scope (source tag: deck and scope filtering) | engine-label (the engine reads it only to label a choice, an event or an offer card) | bot (bot heuristics only) | ui (host catalog / web display only) | unused (no runtime reader). Evidence is 'file:line ~ pattern'; the script fails if the pattern is no longer within 3 lines of that line.

*.source.use: parsed at load into Record::source; ContentStore::from_sources filters every deck, catalogue and lookup by it

*.shortName.use: no runtime reader (two training/report examples only)

*.flavorText.use: no reader except for explores (see explores.flavorText)

*.flavourText.use: no reader except the explores fallback in the host catalog

action_cards.alias.use: identity; effect_for / REGISTERED_ALIASES match on it, one alias per physical copy (mb1..mb4)

action_cards.name.use: printed name; the engine also uses it to merge copies into one option (first_of_each keys the hand by name) and to label discard choices, so it is not purely display; reaction_preview::PREVIEWED and web actionCardTurns BY_NAME key on it

action_cards.window.use: the printed timing sentence is the key of reactions::window_table (exact string, trimmed) that binds a card to an engine event; 'Action' marks a component action (is_component_action, keleres::has_component_action); content::action_cards::timing_of groups ~50 texts by hand

action_cards.phase.use: host catalog phase; content::action_cards::timing_of groups by it; web offersOwnTurnForCard reads it

action_cards.automationID.use: host catalog automation_id; web indexes cards by it too. The engine does not read it: it lists every copy alias by hand

action_cards.playTiming.use: upstream enum-like timing (AGENDA_WHEN, ...) on 16 cards; would be a better key than the window sentence but nothing reads it

action_cards.wildWildText.use: Wild Wild Galaxy galactic-event printing; galactic events are not implemented

agendas.alias.use: identity; agenda_effects::resolve_with and laws match on it

agendas.type.use: 'Law' vs 'Directive' decides whether a passed outcome stays in play (8.20)

agendas.target.use: the free-form 'Elect ...' sentence is parsed (split at '(' then substring 'Player' / 'Planet' / 'Non-Home' / 'Other Than Mecatol' / 'Law') to decide the outcome set; 'Elect Scored Secret Objective' and 'Elect Strategy Card' yield no candidates; game.rs uses starts_with("Elect Player") for Committee Formation

agendas.name.use: names in law-discard prompts and agenda details payloads

agendas.text1.use: For/elected text: engine copies it into AGENDA payloads (strategy_cards::agenda_details) and law prompts; host catalog/score views

agendas.text2.use: Against text, same paths as text1

agendas.mapText.use: text of an elected law, preferred over text1 in the law-discard prompt

promissory_notes.alias.use: identity; generic notes are '<color>_cf' etc. and the engine names them by the bare alias (promissory::GENERIC = cf, ps, ta, an) plus the prefix; Support for the Throne is keyed 'support:<faction>'

promissory_notes.playArea.use: whether a received note goes face up in the play area (and so its effect is active)

promissory_notes.faction.use: owner faction of a faction note (play-area check, faction asset ledger)

promissory_notes.playImmediately.use: would be gameplay (note resolves on receipt); the engine encodes that per note in code

promissory_notes.attachment.use: token/attachment the note places (Terraform...); engine uses its own ids (attachments 'titanspn')

relics.alias.use: identity; relics::use_relic / registered_aliases match on it

relics.isFakeRelic.use: keeps a pseudo-relic out of the relic deck

relics.flavourText.use: host reads flavourText only for explores

leaders.id.use: identity; leaders::dispatch_leader / registered_abilities / faction modules match on it

leaders.faction.use: which faction is dealt the leader (for_faction, with keleres tag rules)

leaders.type.use: agent / commander / hero: readied vs locked at start, unlock rules (51.2a, 51.7), Alliance note, Yin commander

leaders.homebrewReplacesID.use: a reprint (xxchahero-te) removes the record it replaces from the deal

leaders.abilityWindow.use: printed window parsed: starts_with('ACTION') or 'During the action phase' decides whether a leader is offered as an action-phase ability and whether using it ends the turn; also copied into offer cards

leaders.abilityText.use: copied into offer-card payloads (strategy_cards::leader_card); host catalog

leaders.name.use: choice labels and offer cards; host catalog

leaders.unlockCondition.use: host catalog only; the unlock rule of every commander is code (leaders::commander_unlocks)

breakthroughs.synergy.use: the two technology colours that count as one another (synergy.rs, fracture.rs)

breakthroughs.text.use: first sentence copied into the invasion offer card (breakthrough_card)

public_objectives.alias.use: identity; objectives::requirement_for / cost_of match on it (thresholds are Rust literals)

public_objectives.points.use: 1 = stage I, 2 = stage II when the deck is built; victory points awarded (points_for)

public_objectives.phase.use: host catalog only; public objectives score in the status phase by rule, not by this field

public_objectives.text.use: host catalog; the requirement it states is duplicated as Rust literals (see threshold_check)

secret_objectives.alias.use: identity; secrets.rs match arms (counting_progress, nine_ground_forces, Feat bytes)

secret_objectives.phase.use: Action / Status / Agenda: when the secret may be scored

secret_objectives.points.use: victory points awarded (always 1 in the corpus); bot value

secret_objectives.name.use: a Thunder's Edge choice label; host catalog

technologies.alias.use: identity; ownership is checked by exact id (TechnologyId::new("gd")) in ~300 places

technologies.types.use: colour(s) or UNITUPGRADE: prerequisites satisfied, unit-upgrade rules, objectives counting colours, leader effects; bots value colours

technologies.requirements.use: prerequisites as a letter string ('GG', 'BR'; 'null'/'None' spelled out); parsed letter by letter

technologies.faction.use: faction technology belongs to that faction only (90.11); faction asset ledger

technologies.baseUpgrade.use: the generic unit upgrade a faction upgrade replaces (makes the generic unresearchable for that faction)

technologies.text.use: researchability: a card whose text contains 'cannot be researched' is skipped (2 Obsidian cards); host catalog

technologies.name.use: choice labels (research, action-card targets); host catalog

abilities.faction.use: host catalog; the engine takes a faction's abilities from factions.json 'abilities', not from this field

explores.resolution.use: Instant / Fragment / Attach / Token decides the resolution path; Fragment and Attach need no handler

explores.attachmentId.use: the attachment an Attach card puts on a planet; '{id}stat' naming convention picks the research-facility variant

explores.text.use: printed text in exploration offer; host catalog

attachments.techSpeciality.use: technology specialty given to the planet

attachments.planetTypes.use: traits added to the planet (Dyson Sphere?)

attachments.spaceCannonHitsOn.use: planet SPACE CANNON granted by the attachment

attachments.isLegendary.use: would be gameplay (legendary attachment); nothing reads it

strategy_cards.id.use: identity; but behaviour dispatches on the printed name (see name), except te4construction / te6warfare which are matched by id

strategy_cards.name.use: strategy_cards::card_name feeds `match name.as_str()` ("Leadership" => ...) for primaries and secondaries; base2 and pok2diplomacy, base4/pok4construction/te4construction share a name

strategy_cards.initiative.use: turn order and the dealt set; sort key

galactic_events.alias.use: no reader: galactic events are not implemented

galactic_events.complexity.use: the two content sites the pattern finds are faction complexity

genericcards.alias.use: the five plot cards are named in code (ti4_model::plots::CARDS, firmament_plots consts)

genericcards.text.use: not in the host catalog either: the web has no printed text for plot cards from the corpus

exclude_sites.why: event payload key 'target', not the agenda field

action_cards:*.mechanism: id-matched effect (action_cards::effect_for, one arm per copy alias) + reaction window bound by the printed window sentence

agendas:*.mechanism: id-matched effect (agenda_effects::resolve_with) or standing rule (laws::enforced_aliases); outcome set parsed from target; law/directive from type

promissory_notes:*.mechanism: id-matched (promissory.rs consts and faction modules); play area from data

leaders:*.mechanism: id-matched (leaders::dispatch_leader, faction modules, leaders::modifiers); deal and lock state from data; action-ness parsed from abilityWindow

breakthroughs:*.mechanism: id-matched (breakthroughs.rs, faction modules); synergy colours from data

public_objectives:*.mechanism: id-matched predicate or price with thresholds as Rust literals; stage and VP from points

secret_objectives:*.mechanism: id-matched predicate (secrets.rs); scoring phase and VP from data

technologies:*.mechanism: effects id-matched (ownership by exact id); research rules data-driven (types, requirements, faction, baseUpgrade); unit upgrades data-driven through units.json requiredTechId

abilities:*.mechanism: id-matched (faction_abilities::registered, faction modules); the faction's list comes from factions.json

explores:*.mechanism: deck and resolution path from data; Instant cards id-matched (exploration::resolve_instant); Attach cards data-driven via attachmentId + attachments.json

attachments:*.mechanism: data-driven: planet value, specialty, traits and space cannon read from the record

strategy_cards:*.mechanism: dispatch on printed name ('Leadership' => ...), id only for the two Thunder's Edge variants; initiative from data; dealt set from strategy_card_sets.json

genericcards:*.mechanism: plot cards id-matched in factions/firmament_plots.rs; mutated_* twins unused

issues.title: Two extra Veto copies are dealt: the action deck is 142 cards, not 140
issues.detail: deck::build_starting_decks takes every action-card record in scope. veto3 and veto4 are source 'base' records that no official deck in decks.json lists (action_cards_te has 140 ids, action_cards_basegame 80); the dealt deck has three Vetos.
evidence: crates/ti4-engine/src/deck.rs:122 ~ let mut action_cards = ids(content, ContentType::ActionCards, sources)
issues.basis: measured: registry_dump decks_seed1.action_cards has 142 ids incl. veto3/veto4; set difference with decks.json action_cards_te

issues.title: Galactic Crisis Pact (agenda 'crisis') is always discarded and has no effect
issues.detail: Its target is 'Elect Strategy Card'; vote::outcomes returns no candidates for it ('Neither is modelled'), so Game::reveal_agenda discards it and reveals the next card. agenda_effects lists it as an 'availability-only' standing rule, but the corpus types it a Directive and nothing else in the engine names it. The registry counts it implemented.
issues.basis: read: code path; content type 'Directive' measured

issues.title: Classified Document Leaks is always discarded, even when secrets are scored
issues.detail: Target 'Elect Scored Secret Objective (...)' yields no candidates in vote::outcomes in every state, so the card is discarded on reveal; the effect code (laws::classified_leak via game.rs) is unreachable. The test an_agenda_with_nothing_to_elect_is_replaced_by_the_next_card only covers the no-secret case.

issues.title: Covert Legislation is voted as a plain For/Against agenda with no effect
issues.detail: Its target is a rules sentence ('When this agenda is revealed, the speaker draws ...'), which vote::outcomes reads as For/Against; the effect arm is empty and the comment says the driver applies it, but no other code names 'covert'.
issues.basis: measured: no production reference outside agenda_effects.rs

issues.title: Demilitarized Zone exploration attachment does nothing beyond attaching
issues.detail: explores 'dmz' (Attach, attachmentId 'dmz') attaches a record with no modifiers. Its text (return structures and ground forces; units cannot be committed to, produced on or placed on the planet) has no implementation: no production code names 'dmz'. laws::planet_is_demilitarized covers only the base agenda 'demilitarized_zone'. The exploration ledger counts every Attach card as implemented.
issues.basis: measured: grep of engine production code for "dmz" finds nothing

issues.title: Reaction windows are bound by the exact printed sentence
issues.detail: reactions::window_for looks the trimmed `window` text up in window_table; content::action_cards::timing_of repeats ~50 of the same sentences. An errata or a whitespace change in the JSON unbinds a card (the engine then treats it as not a reaction). The upstream `playTiming` enum (16 cards) is unused.
issues.basis: measured: every printed window is bound today (registry_dump)

issues.title: Agenda elections are parsed from the `target` prose
issues.detail: vote::outcomes splits target at '(' and searches for 'Player', 'Planet', 'Non-Home', 'Other Than Mecatol', 'Law'; game.rs checks starts_with("Elect Player") separately. Unknown shapes fall back to For/Against (Covert) or to no candidates (Classified, Crisis).

issues.title: Whether a leader is an action and ends the turn is parsed from `abilityWindow`
issues.detail: starts_with('ACTION') / 'During the action phase'; the doc comment records an earlier bug where no PoK agent printed for the action phase was ever offered.

issues.title: Strategy cards are dispatched on the printed name
issues.detail: strategy_cards::card_name feeds `match name.as_str()`; base2 and pok2diplomacy are both 'Diplomacy' (base2 in the base_game set prints 'ready each exhausted planet you control in that system', the engine readies up to 2), base4 / pok4construction / te4construction are all 'Construction' (te4 and te6 are special-cased by id).

issues.title: Technology researchability depends on the substring 'cannot be researched'
issues.detail: Checked in two places with their own copy of the test; it affects the two Obsidian cards today.
issues.basis: measured: the two records whose text contains it

issues.title: Deck composition uses four different mechanisms
issues.detail: Action cards and explores: every record in scope. Agendas: in scope minus the hard-coded SUPERSEDED_BY_POK list. Relics: in scope minus isFakeRelic. Technologies: decks.json techs_pok_c4 (plus TE) regardless of scope, so a base-only game is offered PoK technologies. The other 23 decks of decks.json are unused.

issues.title: Objective thresholds and prices are Rust literals beside the printed text
issues.detail: objectives::counting_progress and cost_of hold the numbers (6 planets, 8 resources ...); the printed text is display only. threshold_check in cards.csv compares them mechanically: all public objectives agree today.

issues.title: The hard-coded-id test skips 12,005 production lines and merges every category's ids
issues.detail: tests/content_ids_resolve.rs cuts each file at the first `#[cfg(test)]`, which is often a test-only function in the middle of the file (game.rs: 5,448 lines skipped, combat.rs 2,812, timing.rs 838, hooks_cards.rs 775 ...). It also accepts a literal that is an id of any category, so a wrong-category id (36 ids are spelled the same in two categories) passes. Running its rule over the skipped lines finds no dangling id today.

issues.title: 36 ids are spelled the same in two categories
issues.detail: e.g. technology 'mr' and planet Mecatol Rex 'mr', promissory 'ps' (Political Secret, bare alias) and technology 'ps' (Plasma Scoring), agenda and action card 'crisis', relic and attachment 'nanoforge', ability and public objective 'galvanize', technology and secret 'sar'. Literal-reference counts for these ids are ambiguous (secrets.rs b"sar" is the secret, not the technology). A shared string-id namespace or enum would have to stay category-scoped.

issues.title: faction_abilities::blocked names 'your_ships_have_no_shields', which is no ability id
issues.detail: The other four entries are abilities; this one matches no record of any category, so the filter that drops blocked entries once a module implements them can never apply to it.

issues.title: The same field is compared in different ways
issues.detail: window 'Action': trim() == "Action" in action_cards.rs, eq_ignore_ascii_case("action") in keleres.rs; agenda type: eq_ignore_ascii_case("law") in vote.rs, == Some("Law") in laws.rs.

issues.title: The engine reads display text to build labels and offer cards
issues.detail: 62 'Display only' sites (choice::offer_card, agenda_details, leader_card, ability_card, breakthrough_card, exploration offers) copy names, windows and texts into payloads, so the engine cannot drop display text today. Prompts that embed a name are part of the V2 decision fingerprint; payload facts are not.
issues.basis: measured: grep count of 'Display only' in engine production code

issues.title: Card names are copied by hand into code
issues.detail: reaction_preview::PREVIEWED and preview_for match on ~38 printed action-card names; strategy_cards::registered_cards lists names; web actionCardTurns BY_NAME keys 8 names and classifies windows by regex; web pausablePrompts repeats ~60 names as labels; laws::planet_value_bonus_sources repeats three agenda names with their numbers.

issues.title: Id lists that duplicate the corpus
issues.detail: ti4_model::plots::CARDS (the five plot ids), promissory::GENERIC (cf, ps, ta, an), deck::SUPERSEDED_BY_POK (13 agendas), content::agendas/public_objectives/secret_objectives group_of tables (tests catch a missing id, not a wrong group).

issues.title: Galactic events and Wild Wild Galaxy printings are not implemented
issues.detail: No code reads galactic_events.json (20 Thunder's Edge cards) and nothing reads the wildWild* fields of 36 action cards; War Machine documents that its WILD WILD printing is not modelled. Nothing offers them either, so this is scope, not a silent bug.

issues.title: Content records that are never dealt
issues.detail: leaders redcreussagent/commander/hero (unofficial variants under source 'pok'), orlandohero (a Bastion hero tagged source 'pok' although Bastion is a Thunder's Edge faction); promissory 'rider' (superseded by ridera/riderm/riderx); technologies x89_base, x89, md_base, md_c1 (superseded printings); genericcards mutated_* (5).

issues.title: Gameplay-shaped fields nobody reads
issues.detail: promissory_notes.playImmediately (11) and .attachment (7), attachments.isLegendary and .token, action_cards.playTiming (16), strategy_cards.botSCAutomationID; the engine encodes those facts per card in code instead.

issues.title: Coverage ledgers report 100% where some cards do nothing
issues.detail: registry::ledger / coverage_report count a registered alias as implemented; availability-only agenda arms (crisis, covert) and every Attach exploration card count. Combined with I02-I05 the ledgers overstate coverage by at least four cards.
issues.basis: measured: registry_dump shows no unimplemented card in any registry

non_id_literals._doc: Literals the dangling-id scan finds in card dispatch functions that were read and are decision kinds, option ids or payload keys, not card ids.
